name: metabench
description: metabench is a sparse benchmark distilled from six large LLM benchmarks to measure core reasoning and knowledge abilities with fewer items. It identifies the most informative items from over 28,000 test items across ARC, GSM8K, HellaSwag, MMLU, TruthfulQA, and WinoGrande, reducing the size to less than 3% while preserving score reconstruction accuracy.
reputation: metabench is a recent benchmark compression method rather than a long-established standalone benchmark, but it is designed to preserve the behavior of several major LLM benchmarks.
notes: Uses data from over 5000 LLMs; provides estimators for underlying abilities and reconstructs original benchmark scores with low RMSE.
